text.description_html:
Stainless Steel Floor Mount Glass Door Stop / Door Holder

Stainless steel with black rubber bumper rings for use on wood, metal or glass doors up to 2-3/8" thick. Easy to install with single mounting screw. Concealed mounting for a clean installation. For residential and commercial applications including glass doors.

Packaged with all necessary mounting hardware.

Easy to operate. Simply pivot the end of the stop with your foot. The smaller rubber bumper will cradle the door holding it open. Kick it back when you want to close the door. Black rubber bumper rings on both sides protect your doors. Safe door hold open for glass doors.

Specifications for the DWD-SIG723SS-630 Door Stop and Door Holder:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Height of Large End: 1" (25 mm)
  • Height of Small End: 9/16" (14 mm)
  • Diameter of Large End: 1" (25 mm)
  • Diameter of Small End: 19/32"(15 mm)
  • Total Length: 4-1/8" (105 mm)
  • Maximum Door Width: 2-3/8" (60 mm)

Sold Individually
